new_deal_candidates.buyer: Naspers Limited, through Prosus and MIH B2C Holdings
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Major Romanian consumer e-commerce retailer and marketplace. The European Commission notification says Naspers, through Prosus and MIH, would acquire sole control of eMAG by purchase of shares; the Commission decision approving Case M.12496 was dated 2026-08-06 and reported on 2026-08-07.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known_deals. This is a control change from joint/control structure with founder involvement to sole control by Naspers/Prosus.

new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known_deals. Add as a newly announced US acquisition of a European consumer electronics brand.

new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Large German consumer-facing food-delivery and quick-commerce platform. Delivery Hero announced a business combination agreement with Uber; the transaction is conditional and subject to approvals. The official materials also describe a related sale of operations in 14 markets to SSW Partners to address overlaps.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Known_deals includes Glovo, a Delivery Hero brand, but not a parent-level Delivery Hero takeover. This is a material pending indirect ownership change for Delivery Hero and its brands if completed.

new_deal_candidates.brand: Glovo Spain and other Delivery Hero operations in 14 markets
new_deal_candidates.origin_country: Spain / multi-country Europe and other markets
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Material update to the known Glovo/Delivery Hero ownership chain. Official Delivery Hero/Uber materials say SSW Partners agreed to purchase Delivery Hero operations in 14 markets, including Spain, Sweden, Austria, Cyprus, Czechia, Greece, Norway, Poland, Portugal and Romania, conditional on the Uber offer closing.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Known_deals already has Glovo acquired by Delivery Hero in 2022. This should be treated as an update candidate rather than a duplicate because Glovo Spain/selected market operations may move to SSW Partners if the conditional transaction closes.

new_deal_candidates.buyer: Orkla Snacks Sverige AB / Orkla ASA
new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: European confectionery manufacturer with consumer relevance through vegan sweets and supply for Orkla's BUBS brand. Orkla announced on 2026-07-31 that it agreed to acquire 100% of The European Candy Group for EUR 207 million, with closing expected in late Q3 or early Q4 2026. Dutch ACM issued clearance/final notice on 2026-09-04, but Orkla’s own M&A table still showed inclusion in financials as TBD.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known_deals. Include despite being more manufacturer than pure brand because it is a notable European consumer confectionery transaction with official sources and recent regulator clearance.

new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Irish functional soft-drinks brand with strong UK and Ireland consumer presence. Nichols plc announced on 2026-08-10 that it acquired 100% of VITHIT Limited and subsidiaries for EUR 75 million on a debt-free, cash-free basis.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not found in known_deals. Buyer is European rather than watchlist USA/China, but this is a recent completed acquisition of a consumer beverage brand.
